ideas.pitch: A Python and FastAPI tool designed to ingest raw bug reports, parse reproduction steps, and automatically cross-reference them against common software vulnerability patterns to help bug hunters submit cleaner documentation.
ideas.title: F-Cube Vulnerability Triage and Report Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the core requirement of the F-Cube Bug Bounty by streamlining the exact report documentation process judges will be reviewing.

ideas.pitch: A developer-focused tool that maps authorized F-Cube application endpoints and checks payload parameters for missing authentication headers and authorization token exposures.
ideas.title: F-Cube API Security Scope Checker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aids participants in discovering valid bugs within the authorized scope of the F-Cube application.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight telemetry logger that monitors request-response latency across F-Cube application actions to flag performance bottlenecks and UI stutter during bug testing.
ideas.title: F-Cube Performance Regression Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the event goal to improve app performance and user experience alongside pure security bugs.

ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping tool that turns manual click-paths and API calls captured during F-Cube exploratory testing into automated reproduction scripts.
ideas.title: F-Cube Bug Reproducibility Script Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact friction point for bug bounty judges who need clear, reproducible evidence for every submitted vulnerability.

ideas.pitch: A semantic clustering utility that groups similar bug and vulnerability reports submitted by hunters to prevent duplicate triage overhead for Oronzo LLP organizers.
ideas.title: F-Cube Issue Deduplication Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly benefits the event organizers by solving the administrative nightmare of managing overlapping bug submissions.
